goal: Generate a 4:5 vertical character interview cover image, referencing the public appearance of Sam Altman: slender, short hair, mild expression, dressed in simple dark clothing, suitable for cultural and technology interdisciplinary publications or in-depth report header images.

subject.identity: Entrepreneurs and public speakers in the field of artificial intelligence and venture capital in the United States.
subject.appearance: Short hair, refreshing, lighter skin tone, slight stubble, glasses optional
subject.outfit: Dark green or deep brown cashmere crew neck sweater paired with an unstructured charcoal gray blazer, no tie

composition.framing: Character slightly right, with the left 1/3 being a dark book wall and a narrow warm light strip, reserved for vertically placed large quotes.
composition.title_safe_area: Upper left overlapping area and upper middle vertical strip have white text that can compress the dark background

environment.location: An indoor space with a full wall of books and a few abstract paintings, shallow depth of field, with book spines unreadable
environment.depth: Foreground without obstructions, book wall blurred two meters back

lighting.style: A single large soft light sweeps across the face and the single shoulder line from the left front at 30°
lighting.key_light: Warm daylight or window light 4200-4600K, clean triangular lighting on the face
lighting.fill_light: Opposite side 1:3 weak foam board reflection
lighting.color_temp: Overall, it is slightly warm and has a friendly psychological distance.

expression.mood: Calm, listening feel, with a hint of restrained smile
expression.gaze: At one-third from the bottom facing the camera, with a slight 'interview through the lens' feel.

style.rendering: High resolution, low noise, suitable for print magazines
style.tone: Medium contrast, not compressed into low long tone black and white
style.color_palette: Book wall warm wood brown + clothing cool gray + natural mid-tone skin color.

must_keep: The book wall should not display recognizable real book covers or political slogans.
Left area remains blank without fragmentation or cracking
No OpenAI logo within the frame.
avoid: Strong Backlight Silhouette Loses Eye Expression
Pixel-perfect replication of publicly available photographs of characters
